lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ナオコさん、いつも、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Naoko-san, I really can't thank you enough.
lines.style: Warm, respectful opening. Kansai lilt audible but subdued—genuine gratitude, not performance. Slow pace, soft attack. Real feeling threading through.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こちらこそ。達也さんと、メイ、本当に、お似合い。
lines.en: That's my line. You and Mei, you two really are perfect for each other.
lines.style: Bright, generous warmth. No condescension—she means it. Soft eye-contact level delivery, gentle and direct. The satisfaction of someone watching something she set in motion turn out right.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ナオコさんが、紹介してくれたお陰で、今、ある。
lines.en: I owe it all to you introducing us. This whole life—it exists because of you.
lines.style: Kansai warmth underlying, but deeper now. Sincere, almost philosophical. Slight catch on the weight of gratitude. Slower pace. Voice softens on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こちらこそ。本当に、家族になれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: No, thank you. Becoming family with you—that's made me truly happy.
lines.style: Tender underneath the warmth. Not sentimental—practical warmth. Steady voice, quiet conviction. She's closing something important. Slight pause before the final thought.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: これからも、ずっと、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: I hope I can keep earning that. Always, please.
lines.style: Kansai cadence gentle, respectful close. Sincere without formality. Warm exhale at the end. Not rushed—he's extending the moment, letting her know this matters.
